summary: Describes a URN namespace that identifies objects within the Liberty Architecture for federated network identity. It is a namespace registration, published as informational, so that Liberty Alliance Project identifiers can have persistent names.

eli5.summary: If you have one library card that works at many libraries, those libraries need shared names for things. This document sets up a naming prefix for one group's shared sign-in system.

questions: what is the liberty alliance urn namespace
